steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結，並依指示註冊 ShopBack 帳號。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite link and register a ShopBack account.

steps.zh-TW: 透過 ShopBack 到合作商家完成累積消費金額 $800 元以上的訂單。
steps.en: Complete orders totalling $800 or more at partner merchants through ShopBack.

steps.zh-TW: 等現金回饋狀態轉為「已確認」，並更新銀行帳戶提領資訊。
steps.en: Wait until the cash back status becomes “Confirmed”, and update your bank account details for withdrawals.

intro.zh-TW: 透過 ShopBack 到合作商家消費可獲得現金回饋；使用邀請連結註冊，符合條件時你與好友都能獲得推薦獎勵金。
intro.en: Earn cash back at partner merchants through ShopBack; sign up with the invite link and both you and your friend can get a referral reward.

description.zh-TW:
ShopBack 是現金回饋平台：先透過它前往合作商家消費，符合條件的訂單可獲得現金回饋。本站的邀請連結不含邀請碼，不必輸入代碼，直接點擊連結註冊即可。

依來源說明，推薦獎勵須在註冊日起 180 天內達成消費金額與回饋確認等條件，推薦才視為合格，邀請人與被邀請人才能獲得推薦獎勵金；實際條件與金額以 ShopBack 官方公告為準。
description.en:
ShopBack is a cash back service: you shop at partner merchants through ShopBack, and qualifying orders earn cash back. The invite link on this page does not include a code, so there is nothing to type; just sign up through the link.

According to the source, a referral counts as qualified only once the new member meets all the conditions within 180 days of registering, such as the minimum order total and the cash back being confirmed. Only then do both the inviter and the invitee receive the referral reward. Actual conditions and amounts follow ShopBack's official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 此連結不含邀請碼，使用連結註冊即可。依來源提供的說明，朋友需在註冊日起 180 天內完成：使用邀請連結、邀請碼或電子信箱註冊、累積消費金額 $800 元以上的訂單、該訂單的現金回饋狀態轉為「已確認」、更新銀行帳戶提領資訊。全部條件達成後，推薦才視為「合格」，邀請人與被邀請人才能獲得推薦獎勵金。實際條件與金額以 ShopBack 官方公告為準。
notes.en: This link does not include a code; just sign up with the link. According to the source, your friend must complete all of the following within 180 days of registering: sign up with the invite link, code or email, place orders totalling $800 or more, have the cash back for those orders become “Confirmed”, and update their bank account details. Only then does the referral count as “qualified” and both sides receive the reward. The actual conditions and amounts are set by ShopBack.
